record.title: PAVILION ATTENDANT — REASSURING
record.prompt: Exactly 564×278 TRANSPARENT RGBA native pixel-art NPC foreground for separate compositing over the selected matching opaque portrait background. No scenery, no shadow painted on an opaque backdrop, no UI, no protagonist; transparent outside the sprite with pixel-sharp alpha. Match the approved reception portrait density, crisp intentional shading and approachable expressive human anatomy, not a cartoon, photograph or upscale of a scene figure. A human male attendant in his late forties or fifties, neatly side-parted dark hair with a trace of gray, tidy small spectacles, modest cream shirt and slate-teal vest with plain enamel name tab. Seated-to-waist conversation framing, welcoming slightly overeager smile, hands politely together; sincere belief in rules without menace. Consistent model for all attendant poses.
